title: transformItems function has issue with the key name "type"
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

The transformItems function fails silently when using the key ***type***.  It also appears to prevent any other transforms from happening.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**

1. Set up the transformItems function as below:

```php
transformItems(items) {
  return items.map(item => ({
    ...item,
    type: item.name.toUpperCase(),
  }));
}
```

or

```php
transformItems(items) {
  return items.map(item => ({
    ...item,
    type: "Custom Type",
  }));
}
```

2. Create a template using hit.type as a value.
3. In the screenshot below I used the search phrase "District of Columbia Imposes Significant Restrictions on the Hospitality". If you need more results you can use "Background check requirements" as a search term. I've linked a sandbox for testing below.

My workaround was to change the key ***type*** to ***custom\_content\_type\_key*** both in the transformItems function and in the result template.

**Live reproduction:**

https://codesandbox.io/s/elated-banach-02mqd?file=/src/app.js

## 💭 Expected behavior

That using  *type* as a key in tranformItems would either transform the item or fail with an error.

## 🖥 Screenshots

![Screen Shot 2021-08-14 at 2 12 02 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/282426/129458055-51b7ac67-6422-46a3-b82a-6524600d142a.png)

The screenshot above is with the *type* parameter replaced with *custom\_content\_type\_key*.

![Screen Shot 2021-08-14 at 2 26 24 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/282426/129458136-b7715769-beff-46ff-ac6c-1b8d17d16570.png)

The screenshot above uses the *type* parameter. Notice the News & Analysis label (type) is missing from the left of the title. Also the date is missing to the left of the description.

## Environment

* OS: macOS
* Browser: Chrome
* Version: 92.0.4515.131

## Additional context

**Note:**
I'm using a Drupal module the passes along the content type of a record with the key ***type***.
